# Slider

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:wa-slider` · Web Awesome · component · Forms · recommendation: avoid

## When to use

Ecosystem range slider; use the Kerf Slider.

- Range input with markers and value tooltip support.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it in Kerf UI; use Slider (@kerfjs/ui/slider), a native range input, with wireSliders for the live readout.

**Alternatives:**

- [Slider](./slider.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use the Kerf Slider for a value on a range.

## Imports

- Theme CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` once.
- Registration: import `@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/slider/slider.js` once (a side effect).
- Custom element: `<wa-slider>`.
- Declared side effects: custom-element-registration.

## Props

Typed JSX attributes: [`webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md`](../webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md) (import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome` for types only). Use the Web Awesome attribute API; do not reach into its shadow DOM.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [Tooltip](./wa-tooltip.md).

## State and wiring

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: none · padding: child (layout role: forms). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

No component-specific obligations beyond native semantics and a visible or accessible name for every control.

The component renders a native control or link as its root, so it cannot sit in another such component's zones, and its own zones cannot hold a control, a link, or a component that renders one. (`KUI-V014`)

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Theme it only through `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` and cataloged tokens. Do not restyle its shadow DOM or uncataloged `::part()` targets (`KUI-L011`).
